info.name: Referee - Core API
info.description: APIs used by authenticated referees for assigned tournament/match operations.

request.description: profile.total_matches counts distinct accepted scoring matches; profile.rating is the visible verified-review average or null. profile.disputes_count is null because no referee dispute source exists. statistics separates booking counts.
page >= 1 and per_page 1..100; invalid pagination returns 422. This feed contains scoring-match assignments, distinct from independent booking invitations.

request.description: Dashboard uses Asia/Kolkata dates before pagination. Match and independent booking IDs/counts remain separate. today_matches and today_bookings are previews (20 each) with total; recent_booking_requests is a five-item preview. No wallet mutation occurs.

request.description: items[].match_id returns the linked scoring match ID when one exists; null for service-only bookings. expected_fee is not a wallet credit. PAID, PAYOUT_PENDING and SIMULATED_UNFUNDED remain distinct.
